body_html:
Hobie pedal kayaks, tandems, and traditional sit-on-tops at Quest Watersports in Ottawa, IL. Inventory changes frequently, so call 815.433.2200 to confirm availability or stop by to see them in person.

Shop used and demo kayaks · Used kayaks · New Hobie kayaks

Recent pre-owned kayaks

A look at the kind of pre-owned kayaks we take in. Prices below were listed on our previous site; check the collection or call for current stock and pricing.

2016 Hobie Mirage Pro Angler 17T (Dune), $6,499

Hobie's largest kayak ever: a 17-foot tandem with twin MirageDrive GTs (Turbo Fins), full H-Rail tracks down both sides, and a stable walkable deck. Fully rigged with H-Bar, H-Rail rod holder, anchor trolley, Railblaza flag/light combo, four paddles, and dual carts (Heavy Duty and Trax 2-30). 600 lb capacity, and it comes on its Triton LT trailer with spare, a trailered package ready to launch.

2017 Hobie Mirage Pro Angler 14 (Camo, MirageDrive 180), $3,125

Hobie's flagship fishing platform: 13'8" of stable, standable hull with 600 lb capacity. Immaculate and fully rigged with H-Bar, Anchor Trolley, Bass Pro Drift Anchor, Lowrance HOOK² 5 fishfinder, and Hobie Heavy Duty Cart. Custom shark-mouth graphics make this one unmistakable on the water.

2023 Hobie Mirage Pro Angler 14 360 (Arctic Blue Camo), $4,799

The flagship PA14 with the MirageDrive 360: spin the drive a full 360 degrees to track sideways, hold position against current, or change direction without turning the hull. All parts from 2020 with low use. Hull replaced under warranty in 2023 and has not seen water since.

2022 Hobie Mirage Compass (Papaya), $2,339

Hobie's most popular all-around pedal kayak. MirageDrive 180 with Kick-Up Fins handles shallow, structure-filled water with confidence. Oversized cockpit and flat standing deck, molded-in rod holders, H-Track mounts, and a transducer cavity ready for a fishfinder. 12 feet, 400 lb capacity.

2021 Hobie Mirage Compass Duo (Slate), $3,275

The two-person Compass. Dual MirageDrives with Kick-Up Fins (one MD180 with reverse, one with Glide Technology) move two paddlers smoothly and efficiently. 13'6" hull, four H-Track accessory mounts, abundant dry storage, and 475 lb capacity. Adventure-ready for adults, kids, or your dog.

2022 Hobie Mirage Fiesta (Slate), $5,399

A family kayak with four MirageDrive ports, so kids, partners and pets are all welcome aboard. The stable, platform-style hull makes shared time on the water easy and approachable, and four MirageDrives mean everyone can pedal together.

2022 Hobie Mirage iEclipse (Seagrass Green), $2,299

A stand-up pedal board powered by the Hobie MirageDrive: hands-free propulsion on a stable deck you can pedal, paddle, or both. Great for fitness, sightseeing, or a different angle on your favorite water. Ask about deferred-interest financing programs.

2015 Hobie Mirage Revolution 11 (Golden Papaya), $1,799

Fast, agile and lightweight, the Revolution 11 is built for cruising open water and exploring tight spots. MirageDrive pedal power in an 11-foot hull, a great recreational pedal kayak at an entry-level price.

2014 Ocean Kayak Tetra Angler 10 (Tan), $499

A compact 10-foot paddle fishing kayak with molded-in rod holders and gear tracks. An excellent entry point for anglers looking to get on the water without a major investment. Light enough to car-top and easy to launch solo.
